prior.chamber_ratios_note: house 1.0 by construction. SENATE IS ASSERTED AND NOW TESTED (engine/backtest/senate_prior.py): measured at 1.465 on 97 Senate races against 1202 House districts over 2018, 2020, 2022, clustered se 0.420. The asserted value is kept because the measurement does not disagree with it — three cycles of Senate maps cannot separate the two — not because it was never checked. Re-run the module when a fourth cycle exists. GOVERNOR IS NO LONGER A RATIO: fitted directly on 295 polled governor generals by engine/calibrate/fit_governor_prior.py and read from data/calibration/governor_prior.json (2026-09-15; the asserted 1.75 gave 7.08 against a measured 12.6).
